REQ_BTP_SAFETY_GOAL.content: Safety goal: the brake system shall not lose braking capability because the brakes overheat. Decomposed into REQ_BTP_DECOMP_MAIN and REQ_BTP_DECOMP_MONITOR, each ASIL B(D). Illustrative.
REQ_BTP_SAFETY_GOAL.title: Prevent brake fade from thermal overload

REQ_SHOWCASE_BASELINE_001.content: The architecture provides typed context signals for the showcase.
REQ_SHOWCASE_BASELINE_001.title: Provide typed context signals

REQ_SHOWCASE_BASELINE_002.content: The architecture provides diagnostic and display endpoints for the showcase.
REQ_SHOWCASE_BASELINE_002.title: Provide diagnostic and display endpoints

REQ_SHOWCASE_FEATURE_001.content: The brake thermal protection evaluates the brake temperature and publishes the permitted brake action, its status and its events.
REQ_SHOWCASE_FEATURE_001.title: Brake thermal protection evaluates and publishes

SWR-BRK-001.content: The brake controller shall process every brake request within one control cycle.
SWR-BRK-001.title: Brake request processing

SWR-BRK-002.content: The brake controller shall receive the brake request from the pedal interface.
SWR-BRK-002.title: Brake request input

SWR-BRK-003.content: The brake controller shall apply only the permitted brake action.
SWR-BRK-003.title: Permitted brake action applied

SWR-BRK-004.content: The brake controller shall read the rear brake temperature before each brake request is processed.
SWR-BRK-004.title: Rear brake temperature use

SWR-BRK-005.content: A brake request that exceeds the permitted brake action shall be limited, not rejected.
SWR-BRK-005.title: Brake request rejection

SWR-BRK-006.content: Processing of a brake request shall complete within 10 ms.
SWR-BRK-006.title: Brake request timing

SWR-BRK-007.content: The brake request shall be checked for plausibility against the operating state.
SWR-BRK-007.title: Brake request plausibility

SWR-BRK-008.content: The brake pressure shall ramp up at no more than 200 bar/s.
SWR-BRK-008.title: Brake pressure ramp

SWR-BRK-009.content: The brake controller shall be ready to process a brake request 50 ms after start.
SWR-BRK-009.title: Brake controller start

SWR-BRK-010.content: In degraded mode the brake controller shall keep the last permitted brake action.
SWR-BRK-010.title: Brake controller degraded mode

SWR-BRK-012.content: Each rejected brake request shall be reported to diagnostics.
SWR-BRK-012.title: Brake request logging

SWR-DIA-001.content: The diagnostic manager shall process every thermal protection event.
SWR-DIA-001.title: Diagnostic event processing

SWR-DIA-002.content: On a thermal protection event the diagnostic manager shall store a snapshot in non-volatile storage.
SWR-DIA-002.title: Snapshot storage

SWR-DIA-003.content: The diagnostic manager shall serve a read snapshot request from the tester.
SWR-DIA-003.title: Snapshot read service

SWR-DIA-004.content: Brake diagnostics shall be published to the instrument cluster.
SWR-DIA-004.title: Brake diagnostics publication

SWR-DIA-005.content: Diagnostic events shall not be stored while the ECU mode is shutdown.
SWR-DIA-005.title: ECU mode dependency

SWR-DIA-006.content: A failed non-volatile storage write shall be retried once.
SWR-DIA-006.title: NvM write retry

SWR-DIA-007.content: A snapshot shall hold the brake temperature and the permitted brake action.
SWR-DIA-007.title: Snapshot content

SWR-DIA-008.content: A diagnostic event shall be debounced over three evaluation cycles.
SWR-DIA-008.title: Event debouncing

SWR-DIA-009.content: Stored trouble codes shall be cleared only by a tester request.
SWR-DIA-009.title: DTC clearing

SWR-DIA-010.content: The extended diagnostic session shall time out after 5 s without a request.
SWR-DIA-010.title: Diagnostic session

SWR-DRV-001.content: The instrument cluster shall display the thermal protection status.
SWR-DRV-001.title: Thermal status display

SWR-DRV-002.content: The instrument cluster shall update the thermal status within 100 ms.
SWR-DRV-002.title: Thermal status update

SWR-DRV-003.content: The instrument cluster shall show brake diagnostics to the driver.
SWR-DRV-003.title: Brake diagnostics display

SWR-DRV-004.content: The instrument cluster shall display the odometer.
SWR-DRV-004.title: Odometer display

SWR-DRV-005.content: A brake fade warning lamp shall be lit while thermal protection is active.
SWR-DRV-005.title: Warning lamp

SWR-DRV-006.content: Display brightness shall follow the ambient light sensor.
SWR-DRV-006.title: Display brightness

SWR-DRV-007.content: The vehicle state manager shall publish the operating state every 100 ms.
SWR-DRV-007.title: Operating state publication

SWR-DRV-008.content: The operating state shall be valid 100 ms after ignition on.
SWR-DRV-008.title: Operating state start

SWR-GEN-001.content: The brake temperature shall have a resolution of 0.1 degC.
SWR-GEN-001.title: Brake temperature resolution

SWR-GEN-002.content: The core load shall stay below 70 percent.
SWR-GEN-002.title: Core load limit

SWR-GEN-003.content: The service brake shall remain available after a single fault.
SWR-GEN-003.title: Service brake availability

SWR-GEN-004.content: The software shall be updatable over the diagnostic interface.
SWR-GEN-004.title: Software update

SWR-THP-001.content: Thermal protection shall be evaluated every 50 ms from the brake temperature.
SWR-THP-001.title: Thermal protection evaluation

SWR-THP-002.content: Thermal protection shall be initialised at start with a cold brake assumption.
SWR-THP-002.title: Thermal protection initialisation

SWR-THP-003.content: When the brake temperature exceeds 650 degC the permitted brake action shall be reduced.
SWR-THP-003.title: Permitted action under fade

SWR-THP-004.content: The thermal protection status shall be published to the instrument cluster.
SWR-THP-004.title: Thermal protection status

SWR-THP-005.content: A thermal protection event shall be raised when the permitted brake action is reduced.
SWR-THP-005.title: Thermal protection event

SWR-THP-006.content: The brake temperature sensor shall publish the brake temperature every 50 ms.
SWR-THP-006.title: Brake temperature publication

SWR-THP-007.content: The brake temperature shall be carried from -40 degC to 1000 degC.
SWR-THP-007.title: Brake temperature range

SWR-THP-008.content: Thermal protection shall take the vehicle operating state into account.
SWR-THP-008.title: Operating state use

SWR-THP-009.content: A brake temperature sensor fault shall set the thermal protection status to unknown.
SWR-THP-009.title: Temperature sensor fault

SWR-THP-010.content: The cooling of the brake disc shall be estimated from vehicle speed.
SWR-THP-010.title: Cooling estimate

SWR-THP-011.content: The fade warning threshold shall be calibratable.
SWR-THP-011.title: Fade warning threshold

SWR-THP-012.content: Thermal protection shall restore the full permitted brake action below 400 degC.
SWR-THP-012.title: Thermal protection recovery

TC-BRK-001.content: Apply a brake request and check that it is processed within one control cycle.
TC-BRK-001.title: Brake request processing test

TC-THP-001.content: Heat the brake above the derating threshold and check that the permitted brake action is reduced.
TC-THP-001.title: Fade derating test

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

asil.description: The safety integrity level allocated to the requirement.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

document.description: The specification the requirement belongs to.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parent.description: The requirement this one derives from.

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

rev.description: The requirement's revision in the team's tool.

safety.description: The ASIL allocated to the requirement.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

swcraft_path.description: The file in the SWCraft model that declares the need.

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
